**① Run parameters (.mdp)**

It writes the run-parameter file `md.mdp`, which later blocks read:

??? abstract "md.mdp"

    ```ini
    ; Started from the preset lysozyme_md, then changed in this block. The preset: Lysozyme tutorial, as published. 10 ns at 298 K and 1 bar, with nothing holding the protein.
    ; generated by Comfy-gmx

    ; ---- Run control -------------------------------------
    title      = Lysozyme production MD
    integrator = md
    dt         = 0.002
    nsteps     = 5000

    ; ---- Output control ----------------------------------
    nstxout            = 0
    nstvout            = 0
    nstfout            = 0
    nstlog             = 5000
    nstenergy          = 5000
    nstxout-compressed = 50
    compressed-x-grps  = System

    ; ---- Neighbour searching -----------------------------
    cutoff-scheme = Verlet
    nstlist       = 10
    ns-type       = grid
    pbc           = xyz

    ; ---- Electrostatics ----------------------------------
    coulombtype    = PME
    rcoulomb       = 1.2
    fourierspacing = 0.16
    pme-order      = 4

    ; ---- Van der Waals -----------------------------------
    vdw-modifier = force-switch
    rvdw         = 1.2
    rvdw-switch  = 1.0
    dispcorr     = No

    ; ---- Temperature coupling ----------------------------
    tcoupl  = V-rescale
    tc-grps = System
    tau-t   = 1.0
    ref-t   = 298

    ; ---- Pressure coupling -------------------------------
    pcoupl          = C-rescale
    pcoupltype      = isotropic
    tau-p           = 5.0
    compressibility = 4.5e-5
    ref-p           = 1.0

    ; ---- Velocity generation -----------------------------
    gen-vel = no

    ; ---- Bonds -------------------------------------------
    constraints          = h-bonds
    constraint-algorithm = lincs
    continuation         = yes
    lincs-order          = 4
    lincs-iter           = 1
    ```

**② Preprocess (grompp)**

```bash
# gmx grompp
gmx grompp -f md.mdp -c npt.gro -p topol.top -o md_0_10.tpr -po mdout.mdp -t npt.cpt
```

**③ Run MD (mdrun)**

```bash
# gmx mdrun
gmx mdrun -s md_0_10.tpr -deffnm md_0_10 -v
```
